raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Data Analyst with 4+ years of experience specializing in Power BI reporting and data analytics, complemented by 9+ years of core banking operations experience. Proven track record of bridging technical solutions with domain expertise to translate complex banking workflows, financial data, and operational metrics into actionable interactive dashboards. Proficient in SQL, Python, and Power BI for end-to-end data extraction, transformation, and dynamic visual storytelling.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Data Analytics & BI:
Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling), Interactive Dashboard Design, Data Storytelling
Database & Scripting:
SQL (Queries, Joins, Aggregations), Python (Pandas, NumPy for Data Analysis)
Domain Expertise:
Core Banking Operations, Financial Reporting, Risk & Compliance Monitoring, Process Automation
Emerging Tech & Tools: Beginner GenAI (Prompt Engineering, LLM integration for BI), Advanced MS Office
(Excel, PowerPoint)
TECHNICAL SKILLS
BI Tools:
Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, Report Builder
Languages & DB:
SQL (SQL Server, MySQL), Python (Data Cleaning & Analysis)
Office & Productivity:
Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH), Microsoft PowerPoint
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Operations Specialist / Core Banking Officer — Central Bank of India
Jul-2016 to Nov-2025
Managed core banking operations, including account reconciliations, transaction flow verification, and operational
compliance.
Generated daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports utilizing Advanced Excel and core banking software
with high data accuracy.
Identified operational bottlenecks and partnered with IT teams to improve data flow, laying the framework for
automated BI reports.
Executed risk assessments and regulatory compliance checks across diverse banking products, ensuring zero
audit non-compliance.
Mentored junior operations staff and served as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) during major core banking
software upgrades and data migrations.
Designed and developed interactive Power BI dashboards for business units, reducing manual reporting
overhead by 30%.
Authored and optimized SQL queries to extract, clean, and transform large datasets from relational databases for
analytical reporting pipelines.
Built dynamic DAX measures and calculated columns to monitor business KPIs, operational metrics, and
financial performance trends.
Utilized Python (Pandas) for preliminary exploratory data analysis (EDA), data automated cleaning, and data
validation routines.
• Crafted executive-ready PowerPoint presentation decks to communicate data-driven insights and strategic
recommendations to leadership.
• Leveraged GenAI tools to assist in optimizing complex SQL queries, refining DAX formulas, and streamlining
documentation workflows.
raw_sections.projects:
KEY PROJECTS
Financial & Banking Operational Dashboard
Power BI, SQL
Designed an end-to-end Power BI report tracking monthly banking transaction trends, customer account statuses,
and loan portfolio performance.
Enabled branch managers to visualize operational bottlenecks in real time, saving 15+ manual Excel reporting
hours per week.
Customer Churn Analytics & Reporting Script
Python, SQL
Developed Python scripts utilizing Pandas to clean and analyze historical customer transaction data extracted via
complex SQL queries.
Delivered clear trends and churn indicators through visualization, assisting business leaders in targeting high-risk
customer accounts.
